counter_hypotheses: Bid-heavy resting depth can be cancelled and does not establish support.
Cross-venue price gaps can be caused by stale/asynchronous timestamps and quote currency basis.
Derivative OI totals differ materially by provider universe; aggregate totals cannot be averaged.
ETF flows differ because of fund coverage, capture gaps, holdings-delta definitions and re-settlement.
Binance reserve growth may be internal transfers, OTC, customer deposits or reserve replenishment rather than spot purchases.
Institutional custody availability does not establish XRP holdings, payment throughput, collateral use or deployed trade finance.
Circle-Coinbase distribution costs are USDC ecosystem economics, not XRP capital flows.
